summary: The proof is valid as stated. The coordinatewise floor map preserves the resource-box bound and has at most 27 preimages, with the required weight comparison because all penalties are nonnegative. Every cutoff case gives the claimed coordinate factor, including zero penalties and zero side lengths. The uniform-box comparison preserves the original root probability and all three depth factors, giving the fourth power of eta. Reflection and the exact parity-pair count yield M_3(U) >= 1/4096, and the constants combine to 1/[4096(6e)^12]. Weak resource inequalities retain boundary points; singleton and other degenerate supports are covered. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
